probes.name: question-sharp-s
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,c As Range
Range("A1:A2").NumberFormat="@"
Range("A1").Value=("?")
Range("A2").Value=(ChrW(223))
Set f=Range("A1:A2").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
f.DupeUnique=1
f.Font.Bold=True
For Each c In Range("A1:A2")
If c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold Then
Probe=Probe & "1"
Else
Probe=Probe & "0"
End If
Next
End Function
